sentence_stem: The tenant must give written notice before the lease ends, and
correct_completion: failure to do so will result in an automatic renewal of the lease.
full_sentence: The tenant must give written notice before the lease ends, and failure to do so will result in an automatic renewal of the lease.
acceptable_variants: missing the deadline will automatically renew the agreement.
without notice, the contract continues for another full term.

options.text: the tenant may leave without notice at any time.
options.why_wrong: This contradicts the stated obligation to give notice, so it cannot continue the sentence logically.

options.text: failure to do so will result in an automatic renewal of the lease.
the lease was signed in the spring.
options.why_wrong: This is an unrelated background fact that does not follow from the obligation in the stem.

options.text: tenants are often confused by the terms.
options.why_wrong: This comments on tenants in general and does not state the consequence that the obligation sets up.

grammar_focus: Coordinated clause stating the consequence of a legal obligation
explanation: The stem sets up an obligation, and the completion states what happens if it is not met. This is a cause-and-effect relationship typical of contractual language.
translation: يجب على المستأجر تقديم إشعار كتابي قبل انتهاء عقد الإيجار، وإلا فسيُجدَّد العقد تلقائيًا.
